r13_contract.comparisonModel: IF ship_ice_strengthened = true AND construction_date >= '2026-01-01', THEN independent_echo_sounding_device_count >= 2 OR (echo_sounding_device_count >= 1 AND independent_transducer_count >= 2) OR administration_approved_equivalent_depth_sounding_device_present = true.
r13_contract.verificationPolicyBasis: The category policy is based on the source requirement and intrinsic verification method. It is independent of whether any particular LLM model previously succeeded or failed to generate a SHACL shape.

test_cases.rationale: Applicable ice-strengthened post-2026 ship satisfies two-independent-echo-sounder route.
Applicable ship satisfies one echo sounder plus two independent transducers.
Administration-approved equivalent depth-sounding device satisfies alternative route.
Pre-2026 construction is outside amended obligation.
Non-ice-strengthened ship is outside amended obligation.
Applicable ship satisfies none of the three routes.
One echo sounder with only one transducer is insufficient.

benchmark_policy: Source/R13-defined behavioral oracle created without inspecting generated SHACL.
